messages:
raj: Hey finance — quick flag on CumulusCorp renewal invoice INV-2026-3342 for their on‑prem/private deployment. There is a -$119,850 credit line labeled 'platform fee adjustment' that I don't recognize. Did we approve this?
emily: I can pull the contract. Which renewal period is that? March 1 start?
raj: Correct, 2026-03-01 to 2027-02-28. Contract amendment last month increased committed GPUs. The billing system should have rolled forward platform fee, not issued credit.
olga: looping in billing-bot to check metering + true-up logic.
billing-bot: automated alert: matched invoice line to internal event: CONTRACT_AMENDMENT_6543 -> system applied negative platform fee pro‑rata because previous committed capacity was higher than amended commit in billing table. Suggested action: manual review and possible reversal.
emily: that sounds like a mismatch between the amendment effective date and metering window. Raj — did the customer sign an amendment that backdated the commit change?
raj: They signed an amendment but requested effective date 2026-02-01 to align with their internal usage report (they ramped down). Legal approved. I told the account team to expect a true-up, not a credit.
mike: tagging finance leadership — if the platform issued a credit instead of a pro‑rata true-up debit we need approval path to reverse. Any audit trail?
emily: pulling invoice history now. Snippet: ```INV-2026-3342 lines:
  - PLATFORM_FEE_MONTHLY: $45,000
  - SUPPORT_TIER_ENTERPRISE: $6,500
  - PLATFORM_FEE_ADJUSTMENT: -$119,850
  - NET_DUE: $-68,350```
olga: that's the problem — adjustment equals previous commit pro‑rata for Jan–Feb that should have been invoiced as a charge, not credited. Looks like the sign of the delta flipped during the amendment import.
raj: Impact: customer sees a negative invoice and our revenue declines in the month — accounting will object. Need ops + finance to coordinate reversal and reissue.
emily: Recommended next steps: (1) create a reversal invoice for INV-2026-3342, (2) create corrected invoice with positive true-up line, (3) log rationale in invoice notes, (4) pre-authorize a one‑time write-off hold if customer disputes while we correct.
mike: Approve step (1) and (2) — proceed with reversal + corrected invoice. Finance to notify revenue ops and legal. Raj, please draft the customer note; OLGA, can you own reversal workflow?
olga: I can. Will raise ticket with BillingOps #BILL-7382 and tag revops. ETA EOD today if no blockers.
raj: I'll draft the note: short, factual, apologize for churn, say corrected invoice will follow. Will add contact for questions.
emily: Also recommend a quick safety check in the amendment import job to ensure sign of delta preserved. I'll open engineering ticket and tag eng-billing.
billing-bot: task created: BILLING(IMPORT) -> checkDeltaSign. Reference: CONTRACT_AMENDMENT_6543.
mike: Thanks all. Keep thread updated. If customer escalates to legal, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
raj: thanks, will update once reversal issued.
